title: LookBible
description: The one look every shot of a piece shares (ADR 0008): palette, typography, default lighting, motion family, tone mapping, exposure, the finishing grade and the exposure band QA holds frames to. The finishing module turns the grade into a .cube LUT and an ffmpeg filter chain.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

id.description: Slug that names the look, 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example "obsidian". Treatments and shot specs refer to it as lookId.

name.description: Display name of the look, for example "Obsidian".

palette.description: The six colours of the look as lowercase sRGB hex; text must reach WCAG contrast 4.5 over background and over surface.

background.description: Frame background colour as lowercase hex, for example "#0b0b0f".

surface.description: Colour of cards, panels and lower-third plates as lowercase hex, for example "#16161d".

primary.description: Brand or subject colour as lowercase hex, for example "#c9a84c".

accent.description: Secondary colour for emphasis as lowercase hex, for example "#4cc9c0".

text.description: Text colour as lowercase hex, for example "#f4f1ea".

highlight.description: Colour of speculars, rims and glow as lowercase hex, for example "#ffffff".

typography.description: The type system of the look: two bundled families and the scale between roles.

scaleRatio.description: Ratio between successive sizes of the type scale: 1.25 (major third) or 1.333 (perfect fourth).

displayTrackingEm.description: Letter spacing of display text in em, for example -0.02 (tighter) or 0.

uppercaseTrackingEm.description: Letter spacing of uppercase labels in em, for example 0.08.

exposureEv.description: Base exposure of every shot in EV stops relative to the calibrated gray card, for example -0.3; each shot adds its exposureOffsetEv.

qa.description: The band QA holds the picture to.

yavgMin.description: Lowest acceptable average luma per frame as ffmpeg signalstats YAVG reports it, 0 to 255, for example 24.

yavgMax.description: Highest acceptable average luma per frame as ffmpeg signalstats YAVG reports it, 0 to 255 and above yavgMin, for example 140.

createdAt.description: When the look bible was written: an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-26T20:00:00.000Z.

LookPreset.description: Named look the look bible starts from; custom means every value was set by hand.

FontFamily.description: One of the bundled OFL font families.

LightingPreset.description: Lighting setup from the lighting cookbook; every lane maps it to its own lights and calibrated intensities.

MotionFamily.description: The family of easing and timing defaults a look uses for every move and animation.

ToneMapping.description: Tone mapping of the 3D lanes (ADR 0008): agx for photographic looks, standard for graphic looks.

OffsetRgb.description: A per-channel offset added to the picture, each channel -1 to 1 where 0 changes nothing.

MultiplierRgb.description: A per-channel multiplier (gain) or exponent (gamma) applied to the picture, each channel 0 to 4 where 1 changes nothing; as an exponent, a value above 1 darkens the midtones and a value below 1 brightens them.

SplitTone.description: A hue tint applied to shadows and another to highlights.

shadowHue.description: Hue of the shadow tint in degrees, 0 to 360, for example 220 for blue.

shadowAmount.description: Strength of the shadow tint from 0 (none) to 1 (full), for example 0.15.

highlightHue.description: Hue of the highlight tint in degrees, 0 to 360, for example 40 for amber.

highlightAmount.description: Strength of the highlight tint from 0 (none) to 1 (full), for example 0.1.

Grade.description: The finishing grade (ADR 0008): lift, gamma and gain, saturation and contrast, split toning, vignette, grain and halation. src/shared/grade/ bakes it into a 33-point .cube LUT; the vignette and the grain are ffmpeg filters applied at assembly.

saturation.description: Saturation multiplier from 0 (monochrome) to 2 (double); 1 changes nothing, for example 0.9.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier around the pivot from 0 (flat) to 2 (double); 1 changes nothing, for example 1.1.

contrastPivot.description: The picture level the contrast pivots on, 0 to 1 of the display range, for example 0.18 for middle gray.

vignetteAmount.description: Vignette strength from 0 (none) to 1 (strong), for example 0.25.

vignetteSoftness.description: Vignette falloff from 0 (hard) to 1 (soft), for example 0.6.

grainAmount.description: Grain strength from 0 (none) to 1 (heavy), for example 0.15; applied only at assembly, never on stills.

grainSeed.description: Seed of the grain noise, for example 7; the same seed reproduces the same grain.

halationAmount.description: Halation (glow bleeding from bright edges) from 0 (none) to 1 (strong), for example 0.1.
